package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"
)

const (
	TechnicalTaskSchemaV1                   = "technical-task.v1"
	TechnicalTaskSchemaVersionV1            = 1
	StudentTechnicalTaskViewSchemaV1        = "student-technical-task-view.v1"
	StudentTechnicalTaskViewSchemaVersionV1 = 1
	ExpectedResultAcceptanceContract        = "acceptance_contract"
	ExpectedResultHTTPEndpoint              = "http_endpoint"
	ExpectedResultCLICommand                = "cli_command"
	ExpectedResultFile                      = "file"
	ExpectedResultDatabaseState             = "database_state"
	ExpectedResultFunctionBehavior          = "function_behavior"
	ExpectedResultAPIContract               = "api_contract"
	ExpectedResultUIState                   = "ui_state"
	ExpectedResultTestResult                = "test_result"
	ExpectedResultProcess                   = "process"
	ExpectedResultService                   = "service"
	ExpectedResultArchitecture              = "architecture"
	ExpectedResultOther                     = "other"
	ConceptRoleRequired                     = "required"
	ConceptRolePracticed                    = "practiced"
	ConceptRoleRecommended                  = "recommended"
	ConceptRoleOptional                     = "optional"
	ConceptRoleAdaptive                     = "adaptive"
	TaskActionSemantic                      = "semantic"
	TaskActionRunCommand                    = "run_command"
	TaskActionCreateFile                    = "create_file"
	TaskActionModifyFile                    = "modify_file"
	TaskActionInspectFile                   = "inspect_file"
	minimumSolutionLeakSubstringSize        = 8
)

// TechnicalTaskV1 is the canonical consumer-neutral aggregate of a verified
// task. TaskBlueprint remains its single persisted source encoding in v1; this
// projection gives consumers explicit semantic boundaries without storing or
// asking a model to generate the same facts twice.
type TechnicalTaskV1 struct {
	Schema             string                `json:"schema"`
	SchemaVersion      int                   `json:"schema_version"`
	Goal               string                `json:"goal"`
	StudentInstruction StudentInstructionV1  `json:"student_instruction"`
	ExpectedResult     ExpectedResultV1      `json:"expected_result"`
	Concepts           []TaskConceptV1       `json:"concepts"`
	Steps              []TechnicalTaskStepV1 `json:"steps"`
	Verification       []TaskVerificationV1  `json:"verification"`
}

type StudentInstructionV1 struct {
	Title        string                 `json:"title"`
	Description  string                 `json:"description"`
	Roles        []string               `json:"roles,omitempty"`
	Requirements []StudentRequirementV1 `json:"requirements"`
	Constraints  []string               `json:"constraints,omitempty"`
	NonGoals     []string               `json:"non_goals,omitempty"`
}

type StudentRequirementV1 struct {
	ID   string `json:"id"`
	Text string `json:"text"`
}

// ExpectedResultV1 is a discriminated contract. The generated v1 projection
// materializes existing acceptance data as acceptance_contract; v1 also defines
// typed HTTP, CLI, file, state, and behavior variants for compatible producers.
type ExpectedResultV1 struct {
	Type     string                      `json:"type"`
	Outcomes []ExpectedOutcomeV1         `json:"outcomes,omitempty"`
	HTTP     *HTTPExpectedResultV1       `json:"http,omitempty"`
	Command  *CommandExpectedResultV1    `json:"command,omitempty"`
	File     *FileExpectedResultV1       `json:"file,omitempty"`
	State    *StructuredExpectedResultV1 `json:"state,omitempty"`
}

type ExpectedOutcomeV1 struct {
	ID           string `json:"id"`
	Description  string `json:"description"`
	EvidenceKind string `json:"evidence_kind"`
}

type HTTPExpectedResultV1 struct {
	ID          string          `json:"id"`
	Method      string          `json:"method"`
	Path        string          `json:"path"`
	Status      int             `json:"status"`
	ContentType string          `json:"content_type,omitempty"`
	Body        json.RawMessage `json:"body,omitempty"`
}

type CommandExpectedResultV1 struct {
	ID       string `json:"id"`
	Command  string `json:"command"`
	ExitCode int    `json:"exit_code"`
}

type FileExpectedResultV1 struct {
	ID           string   `json:"id"`
	Path         string   `json:"path"`
	MustExist    bool     `json:"must_exist"`
	ContentRules []string `json:"content_rules,omitempty"`
}

// StructuredExpectedResultV1 covers state/behavior result families without
// embedding consumer-specific execution instructions in the producer model.
type StructuredExpectedResultV1 struct {
	ID         string                `json:"id"`
	Subject    string                `json:"subject"`
	Assertions []ExpectedAssertionV1 `json:"assertions"`
}

type ExpectedAssertionV1 struct {
	Path     string          `json:"path"`
	Operator string          `json:"operator"`
	Value    json.RawMessage `json:"value,omitempty"`
}

type TaskConceptV1 struct {
	Target LearningTargetRef `json:"target"`
	Role   string            `json:"role"`
}

type TechnicalTaskStepV1 struct {
	ID                       string              `json:"id"`
	Order                    int                 `json:"order"`
	Goal                     string              `json:"goal"`
	Title                    string              `json:"title,omitempty"`
	MilestoneID              string              `json:"milestone_id,omitempty"`
	MilestoneOrder           int                 `json:"milestone_order,omitempty"`
	MilestoneDependencies    []string            `json:"milestone_dependencies,omitempty"`
	Dependencies             []string            `json:"dependencies,omitempty"`
	Deliverables             []string            `json:"deliverables,omitempty"`
	ConceptRefs              []LearningTargetRef `json:"concepts,omitempty"`
	ExpectedResultIDs        []string            `json:"expected_result_ids"`
	VerificationIDs          []string            `json:"verification_ids,omitempty"`
	Hints                    []TaskHintV1        `json:"hints,omitempty"`
	Actions                  []TaskActionV1      `json:"actions,omitempty"`
	AssistancePolicyOverride *AssistancePolicy   `json:"assistance_policy_override,omitempty"`
	EstimatedEffortMinutes   int                 `json:"estimated_effort_minutes"`
}

type TaskHintV1 struct {
	Level int    `json:"level"`
	Text  string `json:"text"`
}

// TaskActionV1 is deliberately small and optional. A semantic step does not
// need actions; deterministic consumers may use one of these bounded actions.
type TaskActionV1 struct {
	Type        string `json:"type"`
	Description string `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Command     string `json:"command,omitempty"`
	Path        string `json:"path,omitempty"`
}

type TaskVerificationV1 struct {
	ID                   string                 `json:"id"`
	Type                 string                 `json:"type"`
	Visibility           string                 `json:"visibility"`
	ExpectedResultIDs    []string               `json:"expected_result_ids"`
	ExecutionContractRef string                 `json:"execution_contract_ref,omitempty"`
	HTTP                 *HTTPVerificationV1    `json:"http,omitempty"`
	Command              *CommandVerificationV1 `json:"command,omitempty"`
	File                 *FileVerificationV1    `json:"file,omitempty"`
}

type HTTPVerificationV1 struct {
	Method string `json:"method"`
	Path   string `json:"path"`
}

type CommandVerificationV1 struct {
	Command string `json:"command"`
}

type FileVerificationV1 struct {
	Path string `json:"path"`
}

// StudentTechnicalTaskViewV1 intentionally contains only the public task
// statement. Steps, hints, actions, verification, concepts, and private
// evaluation cannot enter this type accidentally.
type StudentTechnicalTaskViewV1 struct {
	Schema             string               `json:"schema"`
	SchemaVersion      int                  `json:"schema_version"`
	StudentInstruction StudentInstructionV1 `json:"student_instruction"`
}

func DecodeTechnicalTaskV1(raw []byte) (TechnicalTaskV1, error) {
	var task TechnicalTaskV1
	if err := decodeStrict(raw, &task); err != nil {
		return TechnicalTaskV1{}, validationf("technical task shape: %v", err)
	}
	if err := task.Validate(); err != nil {
		return TechnicalTaskV1{}, err
	}
	return task, nil
}

// BuildTechnicalTaskV1 creates the consumer contract from the one normalized
// model output. It performs no model call and persists no duplicate aggregate.
func BuildTechnicalTaskV1(candidate AuthoringCandidateV1) (TechnicalTaskV1, error) {
	// Validate a detached value: domain validation normalizes nested slices and
	// must not mutate an artifact returned by a repository.
	payload, err := json.Marshal(candidate)
	if err != nil {
		return TechnicalTaskV1{}, validationf("technical task source cannot be copied: %v", err)
	}
	var normalized AuthoringCandidateV1
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &normalized); err != nil {
		return TechnicalTaskV1{}, validationf("technical task source cannot be copied: %v", err)
	}
	candidate = normalized
	if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
		return TechnicalTaskV1{}, err
	}
	blueprint := candidate.Blueprint
	description := strings.TrimSpace(blueprint.Source.EducationalAdaptation)
	if description == "" {
		// Older candidate payloads did not require educational_adaptation.
		// Requirements are public student-facing data; goal is an internal
		// pedagogical field and must not be used as public prose.
		description = blueprint.Scenario.Requirements[0].Text
	}
	task := TechnicalTaskV1{
		Schema: TechnicalTaskSchemaV1, SchemaVersion: TechnicalTaskSchemaVersionV1,
		Goal: blueprint.Scenario.Goal,
		StudentInstruction: StudentInstructionV1{
			Title: blueprint.Scenario.Title, Description: description,
			Roles:       append([]string(nil), blueprint.Scenario.Roles...),
			Constraints: append([]string(nil), blueprint.Scenario.Constraints...),
			NonGoals:    append([]string(nil), blueprint.Scenario.NonGoals...),
		},
		ExpectedResult: ExpectedResultV1{Type: ExpectedResultAcceptanceContract},
	}
	for _, requirement := range blueprint.Scenario.Requirements {
		task.StudentInstruction.Requirements = append(task.StudentInstruction.Requirements, StudentRequirementV1{ID: requirement.ID, Text: requirement.Text})
	}
	for _, item := range blueprint.Acceptance {
		task.ExpectedResult.Outcomes = append(task.ExpectedResult.Outcomes, ExpectedOutcomeV1{ID: item.ID, Description: item.Text, EvidenceKind: item.EvidenceKind})
	}

	type sourceStep struct {
		step      Step
		milestone Milestone
	}
	milestoneIDs := make([]string, 0, len(blueprint.Milestones))
	milestoneDependencies := make(map[string][]string, len(blueprint.Milestones))
	stepIDs := make([]string, 0)
	stepDependencies := make(map[string][]string)
	sourceSteps := make(map[string]sourceStep)
	stepsByMilestone := make(map[string][]string, len(blueprint.Milestones))
	stepMilestones := make(map[string]string)
	for _, milestone := range blueprint.Milestones {
		milestoneIDs = append(milestoneIDs, milestone.ID)
		milestoneDependencies[milestone.ID] = milestone.Dependencies
		for _, step := range milestone.Steps {
			stepIDs = append(stepIDs, step.ID)
			stepDependencies[step.ID] = append([]string(nil), step.Dependencies...)
			sourceSteps[step.ID] = sourceStep{step: step, milestone: milestone}
			stepsByMilestone[milestone.ID] = append(stepsByMilestone[milestone.ID], step.ID)
			stepMilestones[step.ID] = milestone.ID
		}
	}
	orderedMilestones, err := stableTopologicalIDs(milestoneIDs, milestoneDependencies, "milestone")
	if err != nil {
		return TechnicalTaskV1{}, err
	}
	milestoneOrders := make(map[string]int, len(orderedMilestones))
	for index, id := range orderedMilestones {
		milestoneOrders[id] = index + 1
	}
	stepOrderingDependencies := make(map[string][]string, len(stepDependencies))
	for stepID, dependencies := range stepDependencies {
		stepOrderingDependencies[stepID] = append([]string(nil), dependencies...)
		for _, milestoneDependency := range milestoneDependencies[stepMilestones[stepID]] {
			stepOrderingDependencies[stepID] = append(stepOrderingDependencies[stepID], stepsByMilestone[milestoneDependency]...)
		}
	}
	orderedSteps, err := stableTopologicalIDs(stepIDs, stepOrderingDependencies, "step")
	if err != nil {
		return TechnicalTaskV1{}, err
	}

	conceptIndexes := make(map[LearningTargetRef]int)
	for stepIndex, stepID := range orderedSteps {
		source := sourceSteps[stepID]
		step, milestone := source.step, source.milestone
		projected := TechnicalTaskStepV1{
			ID: step.ID, Order: stepIndex + 1, Goal: step.Objective, Title: step.Title,
			MilestoneID: milestone.ID, MilestoneOrder: milestoneOrders[milestone.ID],
			MilestoneDependencies:    append([]string(nil), milestone.Dependencies...),
			Dependencies:             append([]string(nil), step.Dependencies...),
			Deliverables:             append([]string(nil), step.Deliverables...),
			ExpectedResultIDs:        append([]string(nil), step.AcceptanceIDs...),
			VerificationIDs:          append([]string(nil), step.ValidationRequirementIDs...),
			AssistancePolicyOverride: step.AssistancePolicyOverride,
			EstimatedEffortMinutes:   step.EstimatedEffortMinutes,
		}
		stepConcepts := make(map[LearningTargetRef]struct{}, len(step.LearningRequirements))
		for _, requirement := range step.LearningRequirements {
			if _, duplicate := stepConcepts[requirement.Target]; !duplicate {
				projected.ConceptRefs = append(projected.ConceptRefs, requirement.Target)
				stepConcepts[requirement.Target] = struct{}{}
			}
			if index, exists := conceptIndexes[requirement.Target]; exists {
				if conceptRoleRank(requirement.Policy) > conceptRoleRank(task.Concepts[index].Role) {
					task.Concepts[index].Role = requirement.Policy
				}
			} else {
				conceptIndexes[requirement.Target] = len(task.Concepts)
				task.Concepts = append(task.Concepts, TaskConceptV1{Target: requirement.Target, Role: requirement.Policy})
			}
		}
		task.Steps = append(task.Steps, projected)
	}
	for _, check := range blueprint.Evaluation.Validator.Checks {
		task.Verification = append(task.Verification, TaskVerificationV1{
			ID: check.ID, Type: check.Kind, Visibility: check.Visibility,
			ExpectedResultIDs:    append([]string(nil), check.AcceptanceIDs...),
			ExecutionContractRef: "private_evaluation.code_structure",
		})
	}
	for _, rule := range blueprint.Evaluation.Review.Rules {
		task.Verification = append(task.Verification, TaskVerificationV1{
			ID: rule.ID, Type: "review", Visibility: "private",
			ExpectedResultIDs:    append([]string(nil), rule.AcceptanceIDs...),
			ExecutionContractRef: "evaluation.review.rules",
		})
	}
	if err := task.Validate(); err != nil {
		return TechnicalTaskV1{}, err
	}
	if err := validateStudentInstructionSafety(task.StudentInstruction, candidate.PrivateEvaluation.Reference); err != nil {
		return TechnicalTaskV1{}, err
	}
	return task, nil
}

func (task *TechnicalTaskV1) Validate() error {
	task.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(task.Schema)
	if task.Schema != TechnicalTaskSchemaV1 || task.SchemaVersion != TechnicalTaskSchemaVersionV1 {
		return validationf("technical task schema/version is unsupported")
	}
	var err error
	if task.Goal, err = normalizeText(task.Goal, "technical_task.goal"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := normalizeStudentInstruction(&task.StudentInstruction); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	expectedIDs, err := normalizeExpectedResult(&task.ExpectedResult)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	concepts, err := normalizeTaskConcepts(task.Concepts)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	verificationIDs, verifiedExpected, err := normalizeTaskVerification(task.Verification, expectedIDs)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateVerificationConsistency(task.ExpectedResult, task.Verification); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := normalizeTechnicalTaskSteps(task.Steps, concepts, expectedIDs, verificationIDs); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for id := range expectedIDs {
		if _, covered := verifiedExpected[id]; !covered {
			return validationf("expected result %q has no verification", id)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (task TechnicalTaskV1) StudentView() StudentTechnicalTaskViewV1 {
	instruction := task.StudentInstruction
	instruction.Roles = append([]string(nil), instruction.Roles...)
	instruction.Requirements = append([]StudentRequirementV1(nil), instruction.Requirements...)
	instruction.Constraints = append([]string(nil), instruction.Constraints...)
	instruction.NonGoals = append([]string(nil), instruction.NonGoals...)
	return StudentTechnicalTaskViewV1{
		Schema: StudentTechnicalTaskViewSchemaV1, SchemaVersion: StudentTechnicalTaskViewSchemaVersionV1,
		StudentInstruction: instruction,
	}
}

func normalizeStudentInstruction(instruction *StudentInstructionV1) error {
	var err error
	if instruction.Title, err = normalizeText(instruction.Title, "student_instruction.title"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if instruction.Description, err = normalizeText(instruction.Description, "student_instruction.description"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	instruction.Roles, err = normalizeTextList(instruction.Roles, "student_instruction.roles", false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	instruction.Constraints, err = normalizeTextList(instruction.Constraints, "student_instruction.constraints", false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	instruction.NonGoals, err = normalizeTextList(instruction.NonGoals, "student_instruction.non_goals", false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(instruction.Requirements) == 0 || len(instruction.Requirements) > 512 {
		return validationf("student_instruction.requirements requires between 1 and 512 items")
	}
	ids := make(map[string]struct{}, len(instruction.Requirements))
	for index := range instruction.Requirements {
		requirement := &instruction.Requirements[index]
		requirement.ID = strings.TrimSpace(requirement.ID)
		if err := addID(ids, requirement.ID, "student requirement"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if requirement.Text, err = normalizeText(requirement.Text, "student requirement text"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeExpectedResult(result *ExpectedResultV1) (map[string]struct{}, error) {
	result.Type = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(result.Type))
	variants := boolCount(len(result.Outcomes) > 0, result.HTTP != nil, result.Command != nil, result.File != nil, result.State != nil)
	if variants != 1 {
		return nil, validationf("expected_result requires exactly one typed contract")
	}
	ids := make(map[string]struct{})
	switch result.Type {
	case ExpectedResultAcceptanceContract:
		if result.HTTP != nil || result.Command != nil || result.File != nil || result.State != nil || len(result.Outcomes) == 0 || len(result.Outcomes) > 512 {
			return nil, validationf("acceptance expected_result has invalid contract")
		}
		for index := range result.Outcomes {
			outcome := &result.Outcomes[index]
			outcome.ID = strings.TrimSpace(outcome.ID)
			if err := addID(ids, outcome.ID, "expected result"); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			var err error
			if outcome.Description, err = normalizeText(outcome.Description, "expected result description"); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			outcome.EvidenceKind = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(outcome.EvidenceKind))
			if _, ok := supportedEvidence[outcome.EvidenceKind]; !ok {
				return nil, validationf("expected result %q has unsupported evidence kind", outcome.ID)
			}
		}
	case ExpectedResultHTTPEndpoint:
		if result.HTTP == nil || len(result.Outcomes) != 0 || result.Command != nil || result.File != nil || result.State != nil {
			return nil, validationf("http expected_result has invalid contract")
		}
		if err := normalizeHTTPExpectedResult(result.HTTP); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		ids[result.HTTP.ID] = struct{}{}
	case ExpectedResultCLICommand:
		if result.Command == nil || len(result.Outcomes) != 0 || result.HTTP != nil || result.File != nil || result.State != nil {
			return nil, validationf("command expected_result has invalid contract")
		}
		result.Command.ID = strings.TrimSpace(result.Command.ID)
		result.Command.Command = strings.TrimSpace(result.Command.Command)
		if !idPattern.MatchString(result.Command.ID) || result.Command.Command == "" || len(result.Command.Command) > 4000 || result.Command.ExitCode < 0 || result.Command.ExitCode > 255 {
			return nil, validationf("command expected_result is invalid")
		}
		ids[result.Command.ID] = struct{}{}
	case ExpectedResultFile:
		if result.File == nil || len(result.Outcomes) != 0 || result.HTTP != nil || result.Command != nil || result.State != nil {
			return nil, validationf("file expected_result has invalid contract")
		}
		result.File.ID = strings.TrimSpace(result.File.ID)
		result.File.Path = strings.TrimSpace(result.File.Path)
		var err error
		result.File.ContentRules, err = normalizeTextList(result.File.ContentRules, "expected file content rules", false)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if !idPattern.MatchString(result.File.ID) || validateWorkspacePath(result.File.Path) != nil {
			return nil, validationf("file expected_result is invalid")
		}
		ids[result.File.ID] = struct{}{}
	case ExpectedResultDatabaseState, ExpectedResultFunctionBehavior, ExpectedResultAPIContract, ExpectedResultUIState,
		ExpectedResultTestResult, ExpectedResultProcess, ExpectedResultService, ExpectedResultArchitecture, ExpectedResultOther:
		if result.State == nil || len(result.Outcomes) != 0 || result.HTTP != nil || result.Command != nil || result.File != nil {
			return nil, validationf("structured expected_result has invalid contract")
		}
		if err := normalizeStructuredExpectedResult(result.State); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		ids[result.State.ID] = struct{}{}
	default:
		return nil, validationf("expected_result type is unsupported")
	}
	return ids, nil
}

func normalizeHTTPExpectedResult(result *HTTPExpectedResultV1) error {
	result.ID = strings.TrimSpace(result.ID)
	result.Method = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(result.Method))
	result.Path = strings.TrimSpace(result.Path)
	result.ContentType = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(result.ContentType))
	methods := set("GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "HEAD", "OPTIONS")
	if !idPattern.MatchString(result.ID) || !setContains(methods, result.Method) || !validHTTPPath(result.Path) || result.Status < 100 || result.Status > 599 || len(result.ContentType) > 255 {
		return validationf("http expected_result is invalid")
	}
	if len(result.Body) > 0 && !json.Valid(result.Body) {
		return validationf("http expected_result body must be valid JSON")
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeStructuredExpectedResult(result *StructuredExpectedResultV1) error {
	result.ID = strings.TrimSpace(result.ID)
	var err error
	result.Subject, err = normalizeText(result.Subject, "expected result subject")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !idPattern.MatchString(result.ID) || len(result.Assertions) == 0 || len(result.Assertions) > 256 {
		return validationf("structured expected_result is invalid")
	}
	operators := set("equals", "not_equals", "exists", "not_exists", "contains", "matches", "greater_than", "less_than")
	for index := range result.Assertions {
		assertion := &result.Assertions[index]
		assertion.Path = strings.TrimSpace(assertion.Path)
		assertion.Operator = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(assertion.Operator))
		if assertion.Path == "" || len(assertion.Path) > 512 || !setContains(operators, assertion.Operator) {
			return validationf("expected result assertion is invalid")
		}
		if assertion.Operator != "exists" && assertion.Operator != "not_exists" && (len(assertion.Value) == 0 || !json.Valid(assertion.Value)) {
			return validationf("expected result assertion value must be valid JSON")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeTaskConcepts(items []TaskConceptV1) (map[LearningTargetRef]struct{}, error) {
	if len(items) == 0 || len(items) > 512 {
		return nil, validationf("technical task concepts must contain between 1 and 512 items")
	}
	known := make(map[LearningTargetRef]struct{}, len(items))
	roles := set(ConceptRoleRequired, ConceptRolePracticed, ConceptRoleRecommended, ConceptRoleOptional, ConceptRoleAdaptive)
	for index := range items {
		item := &items[index]
		item.Target.Key = strings.TrimSpace(item.Target.Key)
		item.Target.Version = strings.TrimSpace(item.Target.Version)
		item.Role = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(item.Role))
		if (item.Target.Type != "concept" && item.Target.Type != "capability") || !validLearningTargetKey(item.Target.Key) || !idPattern.MatchString(item.Target.Version) {
			return nil, validationf("technical task concept has invalid exact target")
		}
		if _, ok := roles[item.Role]; !ok {
			return nil, validationf("technical task concept has unsupported role")
		}
		if _, duplicate := known[item.Target]; duplicate {
			return nil, validationf("technical task contains duplicate concept")
		}
		known[item.Target] = struct{}{}
	}
	return known, nil
}

func normalizeTaskVerification(items []TaskVerificationV1, expected map[string]struct{}) (map[string]struct{}, map[string]struct{}, error) {
	if len(items) == 0 || len(items) > 512 {
		return nil, nil, validationf("technical task verification must contain between 1 and 512 items")
	}
	ids := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
	covered := make(map[string]struct{})
	types := set("workspace", "static", "runtime", "browser_behavior", "test", "review", "http_request", "command", "file", "file_content", "database_query", "schema", "static_analysis", "build", "linter", "runtime_behavior", "custom")
	for index := range items {
		item := &items[index]
		item.ID = strings.TrimSpace(item.ID)
		item.Type = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(item.Type))
		item.Visibility = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(item.Visibility))
		item.ExecutionContractRef = strings.TrimSpace(item.ExecutionContractRef)
		if err := addID(ids, item.ID, "technical task verification"); err != nil {
			return nil, nil, err
		}
		if _, ok := types[item.Type]; !ok || item.Visibility != "public" && item.Visibility != "private" || len(item.ExecutionContractRef) > 256 {
			return nil, nil, validationf("technical task verification %q is invalid", item.ID)
		}
		inlineSpecs := boolCount(item.HTTP != nil, item.Command != nil, item.File != nil)
		if (item.ExecutionContractRef == "" && inlineSpecs != 1) || (item.ExecutionContractRef != "" && inlineSpecs != 0) {
			return nil, nil, validationf("technical task verification %q requires one contract source", item.ID)
		}
		if item.HTTP != nil {
			item.HTTP.Method = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(item.HTTP.Method))
			item.HTTP.Path = strings.TrimSpace(item.HTTP.Path)
			methods := set("GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "HEAD", "OPTIONS")
			if item.Type != "http_request" || !setContains(methods, item.HTTP.Method) || !validHTTPPath(item.HTTP.Path) {
				return nil, nil, validationf("technical task HTTP verification %q is invalid", item.ID)
			}
		}
		if item.Command != nil {
			item.Command.Command = strings.TrimSpace(item.Command.Command)
			if (item.Type != "command" && item.Type != "build" && item.Type != "linter" && item.Type != "static_analysis") || item.Command.Command == "" || len(item.Command.Command) > 4000 {
				return nil, nil, validationf("technical task command verification %q is invalid", item.ID)
			}
		}
		if item.File != nil {
			item.File.Path = strings.TrimSpace(item.File.Path)
			if (item.Type != "file" && item.Type != "file_content") || validateWorkspacePath(item.File.Path) != nil {
				return nil, nil, validationf("technical task file verification %q is invalid", item.ID)
			}
		}
		var err error
		item.ExpectedResultIDs, err = normalizeReferenceList(item.ExpectedResultIDs, expected, "verification expected results", true)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, err
		}
		for _, id := range item.ExpectedResultIDs {
			covered[id] = struct{}{}
		}
	}
	return ids, covered, nil
}

func validateVerificationConsistency(result ExpectedResultV1, verification []TaskVerificationV1) error {
	for _, item := range verification {
		switch result.Type {
		case ExpectedResultHTTPEndpoint:
			if item.HTTP != nil && containsString(item.ExpectedResultIDs, result.HTTP.ID) &&
				(item.HTTP.Method != result.HTTP.Method || item.HTTP.Path != result.HTTP.Path) {
				return validationf("technical task HTTP verification %q contradicts expected_result", item.ID)
			}
		case ExpectedResultCLICommand:
			if item.Command != nil && containsString(item.ExpectedResultIDs, result.Command.ID) && item.Command.Command != result.Command.Command {
				return validationf("technical task command verification %q contradicts expected_result", item.ID)
			}
		case ExpectedResultFile:
			if item.File != nil && containsString(item.ExpectedResultIDs, result.File.ID) && item.File.Path != result.File.Path {
				return validationf("technical task file verification %q contradicts expected_result", item.ID)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeTechnicalTaskSteps(items []TechnicalTaskStepV1, concepts map[LearningTargetRef]struct{}, expected, verification map[string]struct{}) error {
	if len(items) == 0 || len(items) > 4096 {
		return validationf("technical task steps must contain between 1 and 4096 items")
	}
	ids := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
	orders := make(map[int]string, len(items))
	stepOrders := make(map[string]int, len(items))
	type milestoneMetadata struct {
		order        int
		dependencies []string
	}
	milestones := make(map[string]milestoneMetadata)
	milestoneOrders := make(map[int]string)
	milestoneFirstStepOrders := make(map[string]int)
	milestoneLastStepOrders := make(map[string]int)
	for index := range items {
		item := &items[index]
		item.ID = strings.TrimSpace(item.ID)
		if err := addID(ids, item.ID, "technical task step"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if item.Order < 1 || item.Order > len(items) {
			return validationf("technical task step %q has invalid order", item.ID)
		}
		if other, duplicate := orders[item.Order]; duplicate {
			return validationf("technical task steps %q and %q have duplicate order", other, item.ID)
		}
		orders[item.Order] = item.ID
		stepOrders[item.ID] = item.Order

		item.MilestoneID = strings.TrimSpace(item.MilestoneID)
		var err error
		item.MilestoneDependencies, err = normalizeIDList(item.MilestoneDependencies, "technical task milestone dependencies", false)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if item.MilestoneID == "" {
			if item.MilestoneOrder != 0 || len(item.MilestoneDependencies) != 0 {
				return validationf("technical task step %q has incomplete milestone metadata", item.ID)
			}
			continue
		}
		if !idPattern.MatchString(item.MilestoneID) || item.MilestoneOrder < 1 || item.MilestoneOrder > len(items) {
			return validationf("technical task step %q has invalid milestone metadata", item.ID)
		}
		metadata := milestoneMetadata{order: item.MilestoneOrder, dependencies: item.MilestoneDependencies}
		if existing, ok := milestones[item.MilestoneID]; ok {
			if existing.order != metadata.order || !slices.Equal(existing.dependencies, metadata.dependencies) {
				return validationf("technical task milestone %q has inconsistent metadata", item.MilestoneID)
			}
		} else {
			if other, duplicate := milestoneOrders[item.MilestoneOrder]; duplicate {
				return validationf("technical task milestones %q and %q have duplicate order", other, item.MilestoneID)
			}
			milestones[item.MilestoneID] = metadata
			milestoneOrders[item.MilestoneOrder] = item.MilestoneID
		}
		if first := milestoneFirstStepOrders[item.MilestoneID]; first == 0 || item.Order < first {
			milestoneFirstStepOrders[item.MilestoneID] = item.Order
		}
		if item.Order > milestoneLastStepOrders[item.MilestoneID] {
			milestoneLastStepOrders[item.MilestoneID] = item.Order
		}
	}
	for id, metadata := range milestones {
		for _, dependency := range metadata.dependencies {
			dependencyMetadata, ok := milestones[dependency]
			if !ok {
				return validationf("technical task milestone %q references unknown milestone %q", id, dependency)
			}
			if dependencyMetadata.order >= metadata.order {
				return validationf("technical task milestone %q depends on a non-prior milestone", id)
			}
			if milestoneLastStepOrders[dependency] >= milestoneFirstStepOrders[id] {
				return validationf("technical task milestone %q starts before dependency %q is complete", id, dependency)
			}
		}
	}
	for order := 1; order <= len(milestones); order++ {
		if _, ok := milestoneOrders[order]; !ok {
			return validationf("technical task milestone order must be contiguous")
		}
	}
	usedConcepts := make(map[LearningTargetRef]struct{})
	coveredExpected := make(map[string]struct{})
	for index := range items {
		item := &items[index]
		var err error
		if item.Goal, err = normalizeText(item.Goal, "technical task step goal"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if strings.TrimSpace(item.Title) != "" {
			if item.Title, err = normalizeText(item.Title, "technical task step title"); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		item.Dependencies, err = normalizeReferenceList(item.Dependencies, ids, "technical task step dependencies", false)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, dependency := range item.Dependencies {
			if stepOrders[dependency] >= item.Order {
				return validationf("technical task step %q depends on a non-prior step", item.ID)
			}
		}
		item.Deliverables, err = normalizeTextList(item.Deliverables, "technical task step deliverables", true)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if item.EstimatedEffortMinutes < 1 || item.EstimatedEffortMinutes > 10080 {
			return validationf("technical task step %q has invalid effort", item.ID)
		}
		conceptSeen := make(map[LearningTargetRef]struct{}, len(item.ConceptRefs))
		for conceptIndex := range item.ConceptRefs {
			ref := &item.ConceptRefs[conceptIndex]
			ref.Key = strings.TrimSpace(ref.Key)
			ref.Version = strings.TrimSpace(ref.Version)
			if _, ok := concepts[*ref]; !ok {
				return validationf("technical task step %q references unknown concept", item.ID)
			}
			if _, duplicate := conceptSeen[*ref]; duplicate {
				return validationf("technical task step %q duplicates concept", item.ID)
			}
			conceptSeen[*ref] = struct{}{}
			usedConcepts[*ref] = struct{}{}
		}
		item.ExpectedResultIDs, err = normalizeReferenceList(item.ExpectedResultIDs, expected, "step expected results", true)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, id := range item.ExpectedResultIDs {
			coveredExpected[id] = struct{}{}
		}
		item.VerificationIDs, err = normalizeReferenceList(item.VerificationIDs, verification, "step verification", false)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := normalizeTaskHints(item.Hints); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("step %q: %w", item.ID, err)
		}
		if err := normalizeTaskActions(item.Actions); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("step %q: %w", item.ID, err)
		}
		if item.AssistancePolicyOverride != nil {
			if err := validateAssistance(*item.AssistancePolicyOverride); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}
	for ref := range concepts {
		if _, used := usedConcepts[ref]; !used {
			return validationf("technical task concept is not assigned to a step")
		}
	}
	for id := range expected {
		if _, covered := coveredExpected[id]; !covered {
			return validationf("expected result %q is not assigned to a step", id)
		}
	}
	slices.SortFunc(items, func(left, right TechnicalTaskStepV1) int {
		return left.Order - right.Order
	})
	return nil
}

func normalizeTaskHints(items []TaskHintV1) error {
	if len(items) > 7 {
		return validationf("task hints exceed seven levels")
	}
	levels := make(map[int]struct{}, len(items))
	previous := 0
	for index := range items {
		item := &items[index]
		if item.Level < 1 || item.Level > 7 || item.Level <= previous {
			return validationf("task hint levels must be unique and increasing")
		}
		if _, duplicate := levels[item.Level]; duplicate {
			return validationf("duplicate task hint level")
		}
		var err error
		if item.Text, err = normalizeText(item.Text, "task hint text"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		levels[item.Level] = struct{}{}
		previous = item.Level
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeTaskActions(items []TaskActionV1) error {
	if len(items) > 128 {
		return validationf("task actions exceed limit")
	}
	for index := range items {
		item := &items[index]
		item.Type = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(item.Type))
		item.Description = strings.TrimSpace(item.Description)
		item.Command = strings.TrimSpace(item.Command)
		item.Path = strings.TrimSpace(item.Path)
		switch item.Type {
		case TaskActionSemantic:
			if item.Description == "" || item.Command != "" || item.Path != "" {
				return validationf("semantic action requires only description")
			}
		case TaskActionRunCommand:
			if item.Command == "" || len(item.Command) > 4000 || item.Path != "" {
				return validationf("run_command action is invalid")
			}
		case TaskActionCreateFile, TaskActionModifyFile, TaskActionInspectFile:
			if validateWorkspacePath(item.Path) != nil || item.Command != "" {
				return validationf("file action is invalid")
			}
		default:
			return validationf("unsupported task action type")
		}
		if len(item.Description) > 10000 {
			return validationf("task action description exceeds limit")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validateStudentInstructionSafety(instruction StudentInstructionV1, reference WorkspaceFixture) error {
	publicParts := []string{instruction.Title, instruction.Description}
	for _, requirement := range instruction.Requirements {
		publicParts = append(publicParts, requirement.Text)
	}
	publicParts = append(publicParts, instruction.Roles...)
	publicParts = append(publicParts, instruction.Constraints...)
	publicParts = append(publicParts, instruction.NonGoals...)
	for _, file := range reference.Files {
		content := normalizeLeakText(file.Content)
		if referenceContentAppearsInPublicParts(publicParts, content) {
			return validationf("student instruction contains reference solution content")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func referenceContentAppearsInPublicParts(publicParts []string, content string) bool {
	if content == "" {
		return false
	}
	for _, part := range publicParts {
		part = normalizeLeakText(part)
		if part == content || (strings.Contains(part, content) && (len(content) >= minimumSolutionLeakSubstringSize || looksLikeCodeSnippet(content))) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func normalizeLeakText(value string) string {
	return strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(value, "\r\n", "\n"))
}

func looksLikeCodeSnippet(value string) bool {
	return strings.ContainsAny(value, "{}();=<>[]") || strings.Contains(value, "\n")
}

func conceptRoleRank(role string) int {
	switch role {
	case ConceptRoleRequired:
		return 5
	case ConceptRolePracticed:
		return 4
	case ConceptRoleAdaptive:
		return 3
	case ConceptRoleRecommended:
		return 2
	case ConceptRoleOptional:
		return 1
	default:
		return 0
	}
}

func boolCount(values ...bool) int {
	count := 0
	for _, value := range values {
		if value {
			count++
		}
	}
	return count
}

func setContains(values map[string]struct{}, value string) bool {
	_, ok := values[value]
	return ok
}

func containsString(values []string, target string) bool {
	for _, value := range values {
		if value == target {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func stableTopologicalIDs(ids []string, dependencies map[string][]string, kind string) ([]string, error) {
	known := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ids))
	for _, id := range ids {
		if _, duplicate := known[id]; duplicate {
			return nil, validationf("duplicate %s id %q", kind, id)
		}
		known[id] = struct{}{}
	}
	for id, values := range dependencies {
		if _, ok := known[id]; !ok {
			return nil, validationf("unknown %s id %q", kind, id)
		}
		for _, dependency := range values {
			if _, ok := known[dependency]; !ok {
				return nil, validationf("%s %q references unknown dependency %q", kind, id, dependency)
			}
		}
	}

	ordered := make([]string, 0, len(ids))
	emitted := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ids))
	for len(ordered) < len(ids) {
		progressed := false
		for _, id := range ids {
			if _, done := emitted[id]; done {
				continue
			}
			ready := true
			for _, dependency := range dependencies[id] {
				if _, done := emitted[dependency]; !done {
					ready = false
					break
				}
			}
			if ready {
				ordered = append(ordered, id)
				emitted[id] = struct{}{}
				progressed = true
			}
		}
		if !progressed {
			return nil, validationf("%s dependency graph contains a cycle", kind)
		}
	}
	return ordered, nil
}

func validHTTPPath(value string) bool {
	return strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") && len(value) <= 2048 && !strings.ContainsAny(value, " \\\r\n\t\x00")
}
